name: Spellfire Sorcery

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Raw power from the Weave becomes protective light and searing spellfire.

feature.name: Spellfire Burst
feature.summary: Once per turn after spending at least one Sorcery Point as part of a Magic or Bonus Action on your turn, choose one burst. Bolstering Flames grants you or a visible creature within 30 feet 1d4 + Charisma modifier Temporary Hit Points. Radiant Fire deals 1d4 Fire or Radiant to one visible creature within 30 feet.
feature.text: Once per turn, after you spend Sorcery Points as part of a Magic action or Bonus Action on your turn, you can release a burst (from the hotbar): Bolstering Flames gives you or a creature you can see within 30 feet 1d4 + your Charisma modifier Temporary Hit Points, or Radiant Fire deals 1d4 Fire or Radiant damage to a creature you can see within 30 feet.

feature.name: Absorb Spells
feature.summary: When a target fails its save against your Counterspell, recover 1d4 Sorcery Points.
feature.text: When a creature fails its save against your Counterspell, you regain 1d4 Sorcery Points. In this game monsters' spells resolve at once and Counterspell isn't cast against them in fights, so this has nothing to trigger yet.

feature.name: Honed Spellfire
feature.summary: Bolstering Flames adds Sorcerer level to its Temporary Hit Points. Radiant Fire deals 1d8 damage.
feature.text: Bolstering Flames adds your Sorcerer level to its Temporary Hit Points, and Radiant Fire deals 1d8 damage.

feature.name: Crown of Spellfire
feature.summary: Once per Long Rest, enhance an activation of Innate Sorcery until it ends; spend 5 Sorcery Points freely to restore use. Gain hovering Fly Speed 60 feet. Once per turn when hit by an attack roll, spend and roll up to Charisma modifier Hit Point Dice (minimum 1) to reduce that attack’s damage by their total. While not Incapacitated, a spell or magical effect allowing a save for half instead deals no damage on success and half on failure.
feature.text: Once per Long Rest when you activate Innate Sorcery you can crown it with spellfire until it ends (5 Sorcery Points restore the use, no action). While crowned you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet (you can hover); once per turn when an attack roll hits you, you can spend and roll up to your Charisma modifier Hit Point Dice (minimum 1) to reduce the damage by their total (in the game: as many as it takes, up to that number, against an attack that asks); and while you aren't Incapacitated, a spell or magical effect that allows a save for half damage deals no damage on a success and half on a failure.
